nodes.statement: A relation \(R subseteq E times A times S times S \) is computational if and only if there is a function \(f : E times A times S to S_Errors\) such that \[ forall (e in E) (a in A) (s_i, s_o in S), (e, a, s_i, s_o) in R iff f(e,a,s_i) = eta(s_o) \]

  computational if and only if there is a function
  \(f : E \times A \times S \to S_{\mathsf{Errors}}\) such that
  \[
    \forall (e \in E) (a \in A) (s_{i}, s_{o} \in S),
    (e, a, s_{i}, s_{o}) \in \mathcal{R}  \iff
